ua-other-008:H1-cont:v2-primary-context.finding: The active V3i crop includes the beginning of the next unrelated III.H.2 title/table heading, then cuts it at bottom y=270pt. H1 final row ends y=243.85pt; H2 title begins y=261.336pt; column heading begins y=280.536pt.

nondefectEdgeCandidateAdjudications.finding: A next-section title “DESCRIPTIONS OF NEW ARMOR TYPES” begins below the crop edge; source patch shows the full heading below the boundary, with no title pixels within the crop. No crop-through observed.
Running header “TREASURE (RANDOM DETERMINATION)” completes above the crop edge; no glyph pixels are cut by this crop. No crop-through observed.
Printed page-number ink is outside this column crop; no part of the page-number glyph is visible inside the crop. No crop-through observed.
A few isolated dark pixels above the crop do not connect to the F1 title; the title starts fully below the boundary. No crop-through observed.
Printed page-number ink is outside this column crop; no part of the page-number glyph is visible inside the crop. No crop-through observed.

Near-edge pixels belong to following source content below the crop; the final note line “a specific item indicates otherwise.” is complete inside the crop. This remains explicitly recorded as an edge-candidate review, not a semantic proof.

sourceBoundaryFindings.boundaryCensusDisposition: All 43 assets have an 8px four-edge source-pixel numeric census at gray thresholds <180, <230, <254. The census is candidate discovery only; each candidate was visually adjudicated against the clean crop and local full-page source pixels. No-wordbox candidate is not treated as a pass; actual heading cuts in G1-cont and H1-main escaped wordbox candidate generation. See bound numeric JSON, no full page rasters or OCR included.

focusOverlayReview.claimLimit: Visual review confirms focus rectangles align with the target printed labels/value cells in the reviewed overlays. It does not validate monetary values or footnote applicability; focus overlays are QA-only and separate from clean source crops.

scarabPixelWitness.claimLimit: Label-column pixel intervals only; does not approve XP/GP values.

reviewerConclusions.v3i: Independent pixel replay passed 43/43. Five source-crop boundary defects confirmed within the assigned 43-target universe.
reviewerConclusions.v3j: Independent pixel replay passed 43/43. Two target-specific trims cure two confirmed defects. Three other confirmed crop-through headings remain unchanged in V3j; do not treat V3j as fully boundary-clean or promote pending those repairs.
reviewerConclusions.inherentSourceDefects: No source-inherent defect found for the five crop-boundary findings; the complete glyph/row is visible in the original source frame and only the candidate crop is clipped.
reviewerConclusions.semanticReview: No independent monetary-value or note-applicability semantic claim is made; 103 note joins remain uncertain.
